fields.summary_ko.0: Google plans to cut 2027 shipments of Broadcom-designed TPU 8i series by ~1M units (~20%) and increase MediaTek-designed TPU 8t series, expected negative for Broadcom, positive for MediaTek.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amid supply constraints and data center power shortages, Google is prioritizing cutting-edge AI model development and adjusting custom AI processor mix accordingly.
